overview: Amortized and simulation-based inference dominates: diffusion/flow-matching transformers for LISA, recursive agent-designed Bayesian networks, and invertible networks for stellar photometry. Emulators reconstruct Lyman-alpha forest and kSZ velocity fields with 3D U-Nets and vision transformers. XGBoost delivers a Gaia DR3 AGB classification; gradient-boosted trees recover red-giant glitch parameters.
themes: transformer reconstruction of CMB and LSS
